comment: Independent mon.c meatmetal() witness: a hallucinating dwarf Valkyrie drops a stack of daggers, summons a rock mole beside them and steps away while she searches. When the mole eats a dagger, meatmetal() calls newsym(), which draws hallucinatory glyphs from the display RNG. monmove.c postmov() runs only once per monster move, so the port must not repeat that newsym() during its planning pass; doing so consumed extra display draws and changed later hallucinatory monster letters.
